title: Metallica announces Alamodome concert as part of tour extension
text:
Legendary rock band Metallica announced an extension to its latest tour with a concert scheduled for the Alamodome next year, according to a Live Nation news release.

– Legendary rock band Metallica announced an extension to its latest tour with a concert scheduled for the Alamodome next year, according to a Live Nation news release. The release said the Alamodome concert is slated for May 22, 2027. Limp Bizkit and Avator will also join the band on the tour.
Since the tour’s launch in 2023, the release said it has been celebrated as one of the band’s best in over 40 years of global performances. Tickets for Metallica’s M72 World Tour go on sale to the general public at 10 a.m. on Friday, Sept. 25, Live Nation said. Fan Club presale tickets start at 10 a.m. on Monday, Sept. 21, followed by local presales from 10 a.m. to 10 p.m. on Thursday, Sept. 24.
Spencer Heath is a Digital Journalist at KSAT. Spencer graduated from the University of Texas at Austin, where he studied Radio-Television-Film. He’s worked as a journalist in San Antonio since June of 2022. Outside the newsroom, he enjoys watching movies and spending time with family.
